comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
Sigh sadly this has become obsolete. Unbelievably Difficult to make with low demand. I mean this is the best plate you get aside from Ganandor or ASTRO plate.

But still most maritime use cheap rolled plates or spend big and go ASTRO plate so you have competition from both sides. If you have thousands of iron lying around doing nothing and thousands more green ore go for it I guess ehh.

This is probably worth 20-25mil a plate at that price question is the effort and time worth it to you
